banner.description: 21K, 10K and 5K through the Centro Histórico on Sunday, November 8. Entry is free, but timing chips and bibs only go to the first 5,000 runners.

status.title: What hasn't been published yet

registration.title: How to register
registration.intro: From October 7 to November 4, 2026, or until spots run out.

items.title: In person
items.description: City Hall (Palacio Municipal), Jardín Hidalgo S/N, Plaza de Armas. Monday–Friday 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m., Saturday 9:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m.

items.title: Requirements
items.description: You can register yourself and one other person, with a copy of official ID for both. Minors: a copy of their CURP plus a parent's official ID.

items.title: Coming from out of town
items.description: Email a scan of your ID with your distance, category and shirt size to slp.deportesocial2427@gmail.com. You'll get a confirmation if bib numbers are still available.

items.title: Who can't register
items.description: Anyone who registered for a past edition of this race, picked up their kit or not, and didn't run.

registration.kitIncludes: Includes a commemorative shirt (subject to sizes), plus a chip and bib for the first 5,000 participants.

kits.title: Kit pickup
kits.when: Friday, November 6, 8:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m., and Saturday, November 7, 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
kits.where: Auditorio Socorro Blanc, Unidad Administrativa Municipal. Blvd. Salvador Nava Martínez 1580, Col. Santuario.
kits.bring: Bring your registration form and official ID (physical or a photo). Kits are handed only to the registered runner.
kits.warning: There is no registration or kit pickup on race day. If you don't collect your kit on those dates, you lose your spot.

rules.title: Rules worth knowing
items: Awards are decided by official gun time, per World Athletics rules.
Running a different distance from the one you registered for, or finishing without your bib, disqualifies you from awards.
Preliminary results are posted online; there's a 30-minute window after winners are published to file a query.
By registering you allow your image to be used on the race's official social media (except minors).

items.title: Altitude
items.description: San Luis Potosí sits about 1,860 m above sea level. If you're coming from the coast, start conservatively for the first few kilometers.

items.title: Cool morning
items.description: It's an early November start: bring a light layer for the wait and drop it before the gun.

items.title: Arrive early
items.description: The Centro Histórico fills up before the start. Plan to walk in or park well away from Plaza de Armas.

items.title: After the finish
items.description: You're right in the Centro: a good time for enchiladas potosinas for breakfast or a walk around the plazas.

items.q: When is the La Capital del Deporte Half Marathon 2026?
items.a: Sunday, November 8, 2026. The main start for the 21K, 10K and 5K is at 7:05 a.m.; the category for people with disabilities starts at 7:00 a.m.
It's free. Entry includes a commemorative shirt subject to sizes, and a chip and bib for the first 5,000 participants.

items.q: Where and until when can I register?
items.a: At City Hall (Jardín Hidalgo S/N, Plaza de Armas), Monday–Friday 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. and Saturday 9:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m., from October 7 to November 4, 2026, or until spots run out.

items.q: Can I register if I don't live in San Luis Potosí?
items.a: Yes. Email a scan of your ID with your distance, category and shirt size to slp.deportesocial2427@gmail.com. They'll confirm by email if bib numbers are still available.

items.q: Where are the start and finish?
items.a: In front of City Hall on Plaza de Armas (Jardín Hidalgo), in the Centro Histórico of San Luis Potosí. The official rules don't include a course map.

items.q: When and where do I pick up my kit?
items.a: Friday, November 6, 8:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m., and Saturday, November 7, 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m., at the Auditorio Socorro Blanc in the Unidad Administrativa Municipal (Blvd. Salvador Nava Martínez 1580). There's no pickup on race day.
Yes: a finisher medal for every registered runner who crosses the line with their bib, plus trophies for 1st to 3rd place in every division and category.

items.q: How is it different from the UASLP Half Marathon?
items.a: They're separate races. The UASLP race was run on September 27 and had an entry fee; La Capital del Deporte is on November 8, is organized by the city and is free.

actions.title: Running it?
actions.description: Register before the chips run out, and see what else is on in the city that weekend.
